# Google Search Results (~$0.05/1K Results)

The Apify actor [`scraperlink/google-search-results-serp-scraper`](https://apify.com/scraperlink/google-search-results-serp-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.92**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

🔥 ~$0.05/1K results ($0.50/1,000 SERPs) 🔥 **CHEAPEST** Google Search Results (SERP) Scraper with real-time SERP data and support for multiple countries. Billed per 1 full SERP page (~10 results) — making it ~10× cheaper than others.

## Pricing

Pay per event — search result pages $0.0005 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/scraperlink/google-search-results-serp-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/scraperlink-google-search-results-serp-scraper@0.0.92#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      keyword: "nike"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `keyword` | string | yes | `"nike"` | Search Keyword(s) — Enter one full search query per line. Each line will be treated as a separate search. |
| `include_merged` | boolean |  | `true` | Include Merged Result — Include a final merged result row combining all pages (page_number = 'all'). |
| `limit` | string |  | `"all"` | Number of Results — Each page returns up to 10 results. Use 'all' to fetch all available pages. |
| `start` | integer |  |  | Start — Set the result starting number |
| `page` | integer |  |  | Page — Set the page number for pagination |
| `country` | string |  |  | Country — Auto-sets 'gl' and 'proxy_location'. ISO 3166 A-2 code. |
| `gl` | string |  |  | GL (Local Country Results) — Overrides country localization. ISO 3166 A-2 code. |
| `hl` | string |  |  | HL (Google UI Language) — UI language code. e.g., en, fr, de |
| `tbs` | string |  |  | TBS (Time Filter) — Time filters like qdr:d (past day), qdr:w (week), or custom range. Format: cdr:1,cd_min:01/01/2024,cd_max:01/31/2024 |
| `lr` | string |  |  | LR (Language Restriction) — Restrict results by language. e.g., lang_en, lang_fr |
| `cr` | string |  |  | CR (Country Restriction) — Restrict results by country. e.g., countryUS, countryFR |
| `proxy_location` | string |  |  | Proxy Location — Force proxy region. Options: us, ca |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
